title: ophioglossum vulgatum var. polyphyllum
intro: Ophioglossum vulgatum var. polyphyllum, commonly known as Adder's Root or Tassel Fern, is a rare and unusual variety of the Adder's Tongue fern plant, characterized by its distinctive polyphyllous leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Adder's Root include its ability to stimulate the digestive system, reduce inflammation, and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Ophioglossum vulgatum var. polyphyllum include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
